topic: The dictator brought down by secrets hidden inside his own diary
hook: His own diary ended his reign.
script: His own diary ended his reign. Romanian dictator Nicolae Ceaușescu kept meticulous records of every crime, every order, every execution he commanded. When his regime fell in 1989, the diaries were found. They provided the evidence used against him at trial. He was executed on Christmas Day. His own words sealed his fate. Follow for history moments where truth always survives.
